test_get_bucket_number: test the shuffle.get_bucket_number function to distribute keys into buckets with configurable parameters
test_Shuffler_all_mem: test the shuffle.Shuffler class with in-memory buffering for key-value item shuffling
test_Shuffler_disk: test the shuffle.Shuffler class with disk-based storage when memory buffer is disabled
test_Shuffler_sorted_by_key: test the shuffle.Shuffler class with disabled shuffling to verify sorted key ordering
test_Shuffler_duplicate_key: test the shuffle.Shuffler class to verify it raises DuplicatedKeysError on duplicate keys
